value: This report details the current landscape of student loan debt in the United States, totaling $1.777 trillion, noting that annual growth resumed in 2024 after a rare year-over-year decline in 2023. Federal loans constitute the vast majority (92.2%) of this debt, with an average federal balance of $38,375 per borrower and a 4.86% federal default rate. The analysis highlights significant variations in debt burden across demographics (age, gender, race/ethnicity, educational attainment) and examines public support for, and the complex implementation of, student loan forgiveness programs. Furthermore, the report exposes widespread issues including loan servicer mismanagement, institutional misuse of forbearance, and the proliferation of debt relief scams, underscoring systemic challenges within the student loan ecosystem.
